oracleRisk.summary: Hylo's current V2 documentation names Sanctum SOL-LST accounting plus Pyth SOL/USD, BTC/USD, HYPE/USD and the USDC/USD par gate. Its public SDK publishes exact feed IDs and addresses, freshness and confidence validators, and USDC par-tolerance logic; it also includes ZEC, ONYC, PST and ETH feed candidates beyond the documentation's pool roster. These public materials need a complete identity-bound deployed branch inventory and source/runtime correspondence before a known aggregate tier can be curated. The official address directory still labels the exchange V1 and xBTC TBD. No SDK candidate is asserted to be a live funded branch.

branchApplicability.rationale: Observed 2026-10-09T10:33:04Z: the current official SDK commit 30373ffe5f22b54eeae1edc5d11b9fc642b357e3 publishes SOL, BTC, HYPE and USDC feed identities plus additional ZEC, ONYC, PST and ETH candidates. oracle.rs implements full Pyth verification, publish-time, posted-slot and confidence checks, with configurable interval validation from 1 to 60 seconds; par_tolerance.rs specifies the USDC face-value gate. This is public-but-uncurated branch evidence. A complete deployment-bound account census and source/runtime match remain necessary; neither current parameters nor active branch membership are inferred from SDK constants. Keep applicability unresolved and the tier opaque pending that curation.
